name: Neko wa Eien o Shitteiru no ka.
original_name: 猫は永遠を知っているのか。
source:
Office lady x schoolgirl short yuri game.
An OL who died inside many years ago is changed by an encounter with a goddess, and meets a cursed schoolgirl...
